node.statement: Scope repair and negative-mass bridge: argument/lemmas/lem-classical-equiv.md permits def-negative-mass, and def-negative-mass is now registered in this AF workspace. Hence delta(P)=max_i sum_j max{-P_ij,0} is an allowed definition here, so the old missing-definition caveat is superseded. From 1.1.1, Q is row-stochastic, hence Q_ij>=0 by def-stochastic. From 1.1.2 and P=(I+S)/2, Q=(I+X)/2, we have P-Q=(S-X)/2 and ||P-Q||_{inf->inf}<=12 eta. For each i,j, if P_ij<0 then max{-P_ij,0}=-P_ij<=Q_ij-P_ij=|P_ij-Q_ij| because Q_ij>=0; if P_ij>=0 the same inequality is trivial. Summing over j and taking max_i gives delta(P)<=max_i sum_j |P_ij-Q_ij|=||P-Q||_{inf->inf}<=12 eta.
